puzzleText:
All new cyber spies have to attend hacker school to earn their stripes.

On day one at hacker school - new spies are taught the most fundamental truth about cyber operations.

Your teacher turned this truism into a cryptic crossword so that you wouldn't forget it.

Solve this cryptic crossword with the clues below to learn the first principle of cyber warfare.

ACROSS:
1. US Vice-Presidented - Swap J for A to be further along (8)
5: Zed meets headless HERO for nothing (4)
7. SKAT ACT scrambled - very aggressive like a push pin pluralised (7)

DOWN:
2. PRETTINESS mixed refuses to quit (10)
3. THREE EATS - Breakfast, Lunch and T - were very dangerous (7)
4. A female deer - act (2)
6. Brosnan's Bond decides to die a different one of these (3)
correctAnswer: ADVANCED PERSISTENT THREATS DO ZERO DAY ATTACKS
title: Cyber Spy School 101
